issues.t: Automatic transmission failure
issues.sym: Slipping, harsh or delayed shifts, the car stuck in one gear (often limiting speed to about 35-40 mph), or no movement at all.
issues.why: The automatic transmission in the 1996-2005 Eclipse is the most-reported expensive failure. Owners describe broken internal parts such as the wave spring, and some cars needed more than one transmission.
issues.next: Check the fluid level and condition. If the car is stuck in one gear, drive gently and only to a shop. A rebuild or a used or remanufactured transmission is the usual fix.

issues.t: Crankshaft walk on the turbo engine
issues.sym: The clutch pedal feels odd or the clutch doesn't fully release, oil pressure drops, and in bad cases the engine suddenly dies and won't restart because the crank sensor is destroyed.
issues.why: On the 2.0L turbo (4G63) the crankshaft thrust bearing can wear out, letting the crankshaft slide back and forth. Clutch pressure on the crank and poor oil changes make it worse.
issues.next: Have a shop check crankshaft end play with a dial indicator before buying or if the clutch feels wrong. Keep the clutch pedal adjusted so it rests with no pressure, and change the oil on time. A walked engine needs a rebuild or replacement.

issues.t: Clutch failure and hard-shifting manual gearbox
issues.sym: The clutch slips, chatters or won't disengage, or the manual gearbox grinds and is hard to shift into gear.
issues.why: Clutch wear and failed hydraulic clutch lines are common, and the manual transmission synchronizers can bind. CarComplaints lists clutch failure on the 1999 Eclipse around 62,000 miles.
issues.next: Check the clutch fluid level and look for leaks. If the clutch is slipping, avoid hard launches and plan for a clutch replacement before it leaves you stranded.

issues.t: Lower ball joints can wear and separate (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the front over bumps, wandering steering, vibration, or in the worst case a front wheel folding under.
issues.why: Torn rubber boots let dirt and water into the lower ball joints, which then rust and wear. Mitsubishi recalled the cars to inspect, seal or replace the joints (campaign 00V421).
issues.next: Confirm the recall was done. If you hear clunking, have the ball joints checked right away; many cars need new joints now regardless.

issues.t: AWD transfer case can lock up (recall)
issues.sym: Grinding or whining from the transfer case, or the drivetrain binding, which can cause loss of control.
issues.why: The all-wheel-drive transfer case could run short of oil and lock up. Dealers checked the oil and leaks and replaced damaged units (campaign 98V069).
issues.next: Check the recall status and the transfer case oil level. Any grinding from an AWD car needs a prompt inspection.

issues.t: Passenger head restraint bracket can break (recall)
issues.sym: The front passenger headrest feels loose or rattles.
issues.why: The headrest guide bracket in the passenger seat back was poorly welded and could break. Mitsubishi replaced the seat back (campaign 97V081).
issues.next: Ask a dealer to confirm the recall was done.

issues.t: Convertible top leaks or won't fold (Spyder)
issues.sym: Water drips into the cabin or trunk when it rains, or the top won't go down all the way.
issues.why: On the Spyder, the top's support brackets can bend and the seals wear, so the top no longer seals or folds properly.
issues.next: Check the top seals and drain paths. Have bent brackets straightened or replaced before water damages the carpet and wiring.

issues.t: Airbags not deploying or SRS light on
issues.sym: The SRS airbag light stays on, or airbags did not deploy in a crash.
issues.why: Airbag complaints appear for every Eclipse generation. Faulty sensors, wiring or the control unit can switch the airbags off, and the light is the only warning.
issues.next: Have the SRS codes read as soon as the light comes on; the airbags may not work until it is fixed.

issues.t: Passenger airbag cover or dash panel lifting
issues.sym: The dash panel over the passenger airbag cracks, lifts or pops open, sometimes exposing the airbag.
issues.why: Owners of 2006-2012 Eclipses report the passenger airbag door and nearby dash trim separating. Some say dealers could not get parts to fix it.
issues.next: Don't tape or glue over the airbag door. Have a dealer inspect it, and check for open recalls by VIN.

issues.t: Headlight connectors melt and lights go out
issues.sym: The headlights dim, flicker or go out, sometimes with a burning smell or smoke near the headlight plug.
issues.why: The headlight plugs and wiring overheat and melt. This is one of the most reported problems on the 2000-2005 Eclipse.
issues.next: Inspect the headlight connectors for browning or melting. Have damaged plugs and pigtails replaced, and do not install higher-wattage bulbs.

issues.t: Black paint fading down to primer
issues.sym: The roof, hood and trunk turn chalky or white, and the paint can wear through to primer.
issues.why: The clear coat on these cars, especially black ones, breaks down in sunlight. CarComplaints reports an average repaint cost of about $500 per panel area.
issues.next: Wash and wax regularly and park out of the sun. Once paint is through to primer, the panel needs to be refinished.

issues.t: Fuel filler neck or tank rusts and leaks
issues.sym: A fuel smell, drips under the back of the car, or an EVAP check engine light.
issues.why: The filler neck and fuel tank can rust, letting fuel and vapor escape, which is a fire risk.
issues.next: Have the filler neck and tank inspected if you smell fuel, and avoid overfilling.

issues.t: Stalling or no-start from the crankshaft sensor
issues.sym: The engine stalls while driving or cranks but won't start, often when hot.
issues.why: The crankshaft position sensor or its wiring fails, so the computer loses its timing signal.
issues.next: Have the codes read and the sensor and its wiring checked. Also ask a dealer about the 2001 recall for the sensor harness.

issues.t: Crank sensor wiring can short and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine suddenly stalls while driving.
issues.why: The crankshaft position sensor harness could rub on a new heat shield and short to ground. Dealers rerouted the harness (campaign 00V299).
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm the recall was done.

issues.t: Sun visor can break loose when airbag deploys (recall)
issues.sym: No warning signs. In a crash, the passenger sun visor could be thrown back at the passenger.
issues.why: The passenger sun visor can fold into a position where the airbag knocks it loose. Dealers install a tether strap (campaign 15V338).
issues.next: Check the recall status by VIN and keep the passenger visor stowed until it is fixed.

issues.t: Driver seat bolts may be wrong (recall)
issues.sym: The driver seat may feel loose.
issues.why: Some cars were built with incorrect driver seat mounting bolts. Dealers inspect and replace them (campaign 01V005).
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm the recall was done.

issues.t: Fuel return hose can crack (recall)
issues.sym: Fuel smell under the hood.
issues.why: The outer layer of the fuel return hose lacked ozone protection and could crack. Dealers replaced the hose (campaign 00V320).
issues.next: Confirm the recall was done. Any fuel smell should be checked right away.

issues.t: Transmission cooler hose can leak (recall)
issues.sym: Red fluid under the car, shifting problems, or smoke if fluid drips on the exhaust.
issues.why: A poorly made transmission cooler hose could weaken and leak. Dealers replaced the hose (campaign 01V011).
issues.next: Confirm the recall was done and keep the fluid topped up.

issues.t: Fuel tank can leak at a weld (recall)
issues.sym: Fuel smell or drips near the tank.
issues.why: A bulge formed during manufacturing thinned the tank wall at a weld, so it could leak. Dealers replaced the tank (campaign 01V069).
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm the recall was done.

issues.t: Brake pedal sinks from ABS unit corrosion (recall)
issues.sym: The brake pedal goes soft or drops toward the floor, the car takes longer to stop, and the ABS or brake light may come on.
issues.why: Corrosion inside the ABS hydraulic unit can seize its valves. Mitsubishi recalled 2006-2009 Eclipses to flush the unit and replace it if needed (campaign 15V337). Many owners waited for parts.
issues.next: Treat a sinking pedal as an emergency and have the car checked before driving. Confirm the recall with a dealer.

issues.t: Fuel tank strap bracket can split (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no symptoms. In a severe crash with a full tank, the tank could drop and leak.
issues.why: A rear fuel tank strap bracket may have a split from a stamping defect. Dealers inspect and reinforce it (campaign 08V454).
issues.next: Check with a Mitsubishi dealer that the recall was done.

issues.t: Front crossmember can crack (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the front, odd handling, or in the worst case the passenger lower control arm coming loose.
issues.why: The front crossmember was stamped too thin and could break over time. Dealers replaced it (campaign 06V334).
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm the recall was done.

issues.t: Key can come out when not in Park (recall)
issues.sym: The key comes out of the ignition with the shifter not in Park, so the car could roll.
issues.why: The key lock cable may not engage the shifter. Dealers inspect and replace it (campaign 06V414).
issues.next: Always set the parking brake, and check the recall status.

issues.t: Driver door lock switch button breaks
issues.sym: The power lock rocker button on the driver door cracks or falls off.
issues.why: Mitsubishi issued service bulletins making the driver door lock rocker button available on its own, so the whole switch no longer has to be replaced.
issues.next: Ask for the separate rocker button part rather than a full switch assembly.

issues.t: Sunroof stuck or hard to move
issues.sym: The sunroof stays closed or needs a push to slide open or shut.
issues.why: The sunroof track and switch wear or bind, according to RepairPal owner reports.
issues.next: Clean and lubricate the tracks. If it still sticks, have the switch and motor checked.
